name: datavisualizer
title: Data Visualizer
description: Live tables and charts over your data: SQL or app tables, filtered from the UI.

operations.name: open
operations.description: Compose the app surface listing every view.

operations.name: show
operations.description: Create a view from JSON {title, kind: table|chart, source: sql|apptable:<id>, sql, filters: [outputColumn], refreshSeconds}. SQL is a SELECT without a row limit; the app applies equality filters with bound parameters before its 200-row display limit. Charts use the first output column as labels and the second as numeric values. Reuse an invocationId only for the same request.

operations.name: refine
operations.description: Set filter values and optionally replace the SQL of a view: JSON {view, filters: {column: value}, sql}. Re-runs the view.

operations.name: read
operations.description: Refresh and read a view: table columns/rows or chart points plus status. Input is the view id.

operations.name: close
operations.description: Remove a view and its window: input is the view id.

operations.name: refresh
operations.description: Refresh current source data and filter values; input is a view id or empty for all views.
